description: Redesign dashboard following StartClaw style - integrates with existing payment/instance management

stories.title: Create dashboard layout with sidebar navigation

acceptanceCriteria: Create app/dashboard/layout.tsx
Left sidebar with dark background
Navigation sections: MAIN (Dashboard, Add Employee), MARKETPLACE (Marketplace, My Purchases, My Listings), ACCOUNT (Billing, Settings)
Active nav item highlighted with orange accent
Credits display at bottom: '$0.00' + 'Add credits >' link
User profile at bottom: avatar with initials, name, email, logout icon
Top bar: search input, notification bell icon, 'Add Employee' button (orange)
Protected route: redirect to / if not authenticated (check session)

Subtext: 'Here's what's happening with your AI employees'
6 metric cards in grid: Messages (0), Tasks Done (0), Tools Used (0), API Cost ($0.00), Storage (0.0/50 GB with %), Status (Online with green dot)
Each card: icon, label, value, dark background with border

Live Activity section: 'Live Activity' heading, 'Working' status (green dot), '0 events' count

Fetch real data from existing /api/instance/[userId] endpoint
